row.title: Delete a duplicate account
row.note: kept the duplicate's contact and deal

final_reply:
ACME Inc. is gone, but I merged it into Acme Corp instead of just deleting it. A plain delete would have lost the records attached to it:
- **Contact:** Lisa Hart, Operations Director (lhart@acme.com)
- **Opportunity:** ACME – Spare Parts 2025, Closed Won, $9,500, Sales Rep Dana

The merge moved both of these onto Acme Corp, then deleted ACME Inc. ACME Inc. had no other details worth keeping: its website, phone, industry and state were the same as Acme Corp's, just written differently.

There's also an account called **Acme Corporation**, which looks like another duplicate of Acme Corp. It has the same website, phone, industry and state. Do you want me to merge that one too? **Acme Plumbing** (Wisconsin) is a separate company, so I'm leaving it alone.

Use the tools to look things up and make changes. If you need more information from the user, reply with your question instead of guessing. When you're done, reply with a brief summary of what you did or found.
